freeze_rule: Commit before new external-state evaluation, spatial transformations, inversion certificates or residuals. Source acquisition, constants and symbolic derivation precede freeze. Retain every case; no tuning.
scope: Spatial component at each frozen Mission 43 event argument, not a new coupled spacetime/clock or combined arrival solution.

mapping.input: Mission 43 nominal WGS84 rotated vector is explicitly assumed TT-compatible for this experiment. This is a declared coordinate-scale interpretation, not a survey certification.
mapping.unscale: F_B=1-L_B; F_G=1-L_G; X=X_TT/F_G; v_TCB=v_TDB; W_TCB=W_TDB; a_TCB=F_B*a_TDB.
mapping.polynomial: H(r)=r+P(r)/c^2; P(r)=v*(v dot r)/2 + W*r + r*(a dot r) - a*(r dot r)/2.
mapping.inverse: Solve H(r)=X, then r_TDB=F_B*r. r=x_station(t)-x_E(t) uses a common TCB event argument; do not substitute Earth evaluated at a different coordinate time.
mapping.inverse_order: r1=X-P(X)/c^2 is the first-order inverse; r4 is four fixed-point updates with each reference update rounded to a 1e-30 m grid.
mapping.time_argument: Hold each Mission 43 final actual binary64 ET fixed. Its archived TT/site position and Earth velocity are retained; the clock is not re-solved.
mapping.omitted: The exact root of this truncated polynomial is not the exact relativistic transformation. O(c^-4) spatial terms, full spacetime coupling, physical input errors and omitted gravity remain unbounded.

gravity.description: Sun, seven non-Earth planetary-system barycentres, Pluto-system barycentre and Moon; Earth and EMB excluded. Ten point monopoles only.
gravity.positions: CSPICE spkezr(body, ET, J2000, NONE, 399), metres, TDB-compatible geometric differences.
gravity.coefficients: W=sum(mu_i/|d_i|); a_TDB=sum(mu_i*d_i/|d_i|^3); mu_TDB in m^3/s^2. No Earth self-potential.
gravity.omission_status: Planetary systems represented at barycentres; asteroids, KBOs, multipoles and relativistic force corrections omitted; no physical bound inferred.

design.threshold_meaning: Engineering checks predeclared without residual tuning; no physical accuracy acceptance threshold.

certificate.bound: norm1(H(z)-X)/(1-q), for z in ball, q<1; exact Fraction arithmetic on supplied decimal coefficients; display rounded upward to 1e-36 m.
certificate.meaning: Certified error relative to the unique root of the declared polynomial for supplied inputs only. Excludes ephemeris, coordinate and omitted-physics uncertainty.

diagnostics: dot(v,r_TDB-X_TT)/c^2 as fixed-argument frame-only clock-term change, not a new clock or arrival residual

sources.locator: Soffel et al. 2003 Appendix A, printed page 35, B1.3 recommendation 4
sources.role: Full c^-2 spatial transformation; explicit omitted O(c^-4).
TDB/TT compatible coordinate and mass scaling; mixed models require explicit factors.
ITRF conventions motivate TT-compatible scale; nominal WGS84 inputs do not establish surveyed ITRF realization.

sources.domain: Full specified formulation, farther than a few solar radii; TCB/TCG transformation within 50000 km of Earth; astronomical input errors may be larger.
sources.assessment: Conditional formulation accuracy, not a complete DE440t or truncated spatial-model bound; no automatic transfer.
Expectation for drift with other ephemerides and conventional normalization; not a measured DE440t error envelope or fitted correction.
Integrated clock formulation and source model; does not supply an applicable complete site-clock hard bound in the inspected section.
